players.bio: Andrew John Woodman (born 11 August 1971) is an English football manager and former player, who played as a goalkeeper. He is currently the manager of EFL League Two club Bromley. Woodman made league appearances for 10 clubs in England during his playing career.

Ashley James Charles is a footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley. Born in England, he plays for the Grenada national team. Club career Charles is a youth product of his local club Watford since U14 level, and signed a contract with them on 7 June 2016 before going professional in 2017.

Ben Rhys Thompson is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Bromley F.C. in EFL League One. He was born on 3 October 1995 in Sidcup, England. He made his senior debut on 26 August 2014, as a 76th-minute substitute for Nadjim Abdou in a 0–2 home defeat to Southampton in the second round of the League Cup.

Chanse Allan Headman (born 3 June 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for EFL League One club Bromley. Headman is a product of a number of non-League youth systems and began his professional career with Brentford in 2023. After three years with the club's B team, he began his senior career with Harrogate Town in 2026.
Corey Milton Whitely (born 11 July 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Bromley.
Deonysus Sangai Woodman is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Bromley. Born in England, he represents the Kenya national football team.
Ethon Emmanuel Archer (born 28 August 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bromley FC.
Nathan Patten (Nathan Robert Patten) is an 18-year-old professional footballer from England who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Bromley F.C..

George Alan Saville is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley and the Northern Ireland national team. Saville began his senior career with Chelsea but did not make a first team appearance. His first professional games came on loan at Millwall and Brentford respectively.

Grant Ashley Smith (born 20 November 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Bromley. Career Smith began his career playing in the youth system of Eldon Celtic before joining the academy of Reading in 2007, before moving to Fulham.

Jacob Mendy is a 29-year-old Gambian professional footballer who plays as a wing-back or winger for Bromley F.C.. Known for his blistering pace and versatile left-sided play, Mendy is famously recognised as part of the core group of players that helped Wrexham A.F.C. secure back-to-back promotions up the English football pyramid.

Jesse John Kodjo Debrah (born 1 May 2000) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Bromley, on loan from EFL League One club Port Vale. Debrah joined Millwall at the age of ten, though he would leave the club without playing a first-team game following loan spells with Billericay Town, Eastbourne Borough and Dulwich Hamlet.
Jodi Felice Jones (born 22 October 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bromley F.C. Born in England, he plays for the Malta national team.
John Joshua "JJ" McKiernan is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley.
Kamarl Antonio Grant (born 26 January 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bromley, on loan from EFL Championship club Millwall.
Kamil Amadu Conteh is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley. Born in England, he plays for the Sierra Leone national team.
Marcus Lemar Ifill (born 2 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Bromley..

Michael Cheek (born 23 August 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Bromley. The 2020-21 season saw the prolific striker pick up the National League Golden Boot award, bagging 21 goals, nine more than his first campaign with the club. Cheek made his mark at Heybridge Swifts before moving to Chelmsford City.
Mickel Miller is an English professional footballer who plays as a wing-back or winger for Bromley F.C. in EFL League One.
Mitchell Bernard Pinnock (born 12 December 1994) is an English footballer who plays for EFL League One club Bromley.

Nicke Kabamba (born 1 February 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a 6-foot-3-inch striker for Bromley F.C. in EFL League One. Born in Brent, London, Kabamba started his career in non-League football. He started his career with Hayes & Yeading before subsequently moving to Uxbridge, A.F.C. Hayes, Burnham, Hemel Hempstead Town and Hampton & Richmond Borough.

Omar Kolawole Olufemi Sowunmi (born 7 November 1995) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Bromley. Primarily a defender, Sowunmi has played as a striker in the past.

Owen Mason is a 22-year-old professional football goalkeeper who plays for English League One club Bromley. Owen Mason progressed through the Academy at Mansfield Town and signed a scholarship with the Stags in the summer of 2020. The 6ft 3in goalkeeper was capped for the Republic of Ireland under-19s’ side and called up to their under-21s.
Richard Akinfolarin Taylor (born 2 October 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Bromley, on loan from EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers.
Shamal Tyrell George (born 6 January 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for League One club Bromley
Soul Alidean Kader (born 31 January 2004) is an English professional footballer who currently plays as a striker for EFL League One club Bromley.
Tobias Toumai Moses Brenan is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley
Ayomide Victor Adeboyejolisten is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Bromley. He signed from EFL League One side Burton Albion in January of 2023.

William Mbongo Desire Hondermarck (born 21 November 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bromley. Born in France, he plays for the Congo national football team.
